observation: The completed S3 memory is active but does not show consistent public gain. A standard-library audit verified 49 frozen source hashes and reconstructed 11880 saved rows (maximum NLL error 2.22e-15). The base fit ends in 2011, calibration ends in 2016/2017, memory weights are selected from 22 validation months with 0.000925-0.006061 nat gains, and 103-dimensional unit keys use mean squared distance that nearly flattens similarity weighting.
hypothesized_cause: Stale base/calibration, noisy selection and weak retrieval relevance are competing explanations. Source/algebraic and descriptive evidence does not isolate a causal driver or prove a performance remedy.
change: Save a dated diagnosis, reproducible artifact audit and full research-completion checklist. Add the diagnosis to canonical state. No model, protocol, grid, threshold, seed, data, or completed-run changes; no new experiment is declared or executed.
predicted_effect: Future successor work can test recent fitting/calibration, dimension-independent similarity and conservative memory selection separately, while preserving valid predecessor outcomes and the protected boundary.
discriminating_experiment: Proposed only: fixed-budget fresh rolling-origin successor with same-checkpoint off, matched random/recent controls, isolated interventions and zero fallback. Requires a separately specified protocol and fresh evidence; benefit is unknown.
predecessor_disposition: S2 and S3 remain closed with their existing mixed/unsupported exploratory results; canonical scientific status remains NOT_EVALUATED
